pages.main_text_excerpt:
Who are we?
Josef Akademi - Bible School for Entrepreneurs
Josef Akademi Bible School for Entrepreneurs is a one-year program. You need NO qualifications apart from an idea and aspirations you want to develop.
Josef Akademi has as it’s main purpose, educating people for personal development, leadership and entrepreneurship based on Christian values, where the various parts of the education put a holistic focus on important arenas in the individual student’s life.
The program is approved by the Directorate of Education (Utdanningsdirektoratet) and for loans and scholarships through the Loan Fund (Låndekassen).
HOW TO APPLY?
Take the step now! Complete our online application form under the admission section. Admission takes place as long as space is available. Click here..
